description: Real schema of AQMSADPHCINDOOR database. Used by the LLM to understand table/column semantics without direct schema access.
rbac_note: Every query is automatically restricted to the sites the user is permitted to access. The system injects a StationID/site_id filter based on the user's assigned sites — the LLM does NOT need to add site filtering manually. When a user asks 'show me my sites' or 'which devices can I see', query DMN_Stations and DMN_Devices — the RBAC layer will automatically scope results to their permitted sites only. Admin users see all sites.

ParameterReadings.description: Live/current 5-minute sensor readings per device parameter. Main real-time data table. One row per parameter per device per reading interval.

columns.StationID: Foreign key to DMN_Stations.ID — the monitoring location
columns.DeviceID: Foreign key to DMN_Devices.ID — the physical sensor device
columns.ParameterID: Foreign key to DMN_Parameters.ID — which pollutant/parameter
columns.ParameterIDRef: Foreign key to DMN_Parameters.ParameterID — which pollutant/parameter
columns.Parametervalue: The measured value (float) in the unit defined by DMN_Parameters.UnitID
columns.CreatedTime: Timestamp of the reading (datetime) — use for time filtering
columns.Alarm: Alarm state at time of reading
columns.SubIndex: AQI sub-index calculated for this parameter reading

ParameterAverages.description: Hourly averages of sensor readings per device/parameter. Use for trend analysis and historical queries. Same structure as ParameterReadings but aggregated.

columns.ParameterIDRef: Foreign key to DMN_Parameters.ParameterID — which pollutant/parameter
columns.Parametervalue: Average parameter value for the interval (float)
columns.Interval: Start datetime of the averaging interval — use for date filtering
columns.SubIndex: AQI sub-index for this averaged reading

ParameterAveragesMonth.description: Monthly averages of sensor readings. Use for month-over-month and long-term trend queries.

columns.Interval: Month start datetime — use for date filtering

ParameterAveragesYear.description: Annual averages of sensor readings. Use for year-over-year comparisons.

DMN_Stations.description: Master sites/stations table. Each row is a monitoring location (building, facility, or outdoor site) created by Admin. Stores site identity, sector classification, geographic coordinates for map display, and operational flags. Use this table to answer 'which sites can I access?', 'show me my stations', 'list active sites', 'show sites in a region/sector' — RBAC automatically filters results to only the sites the user is permitted to see.
DMN_Stations.key_join: DMN_Stations.SectorID = Sectors.Id | DMN_Stations.SubSectorID = SubSectors.Id | DMN_Stations.RegionID = Regions.Id
DMN_Stations.admin_note: Sites are created by Admin only. Fields: SiteName (required), SectorID (required), SubSectorID (optional), RegionID (required), CoordinateX/Y (optional, for map), Status (Active/Inactive), moldtest (Yes/No), Description (optional).

columns.ID: Primary key — use as StationID in all joins to data tables
columns.StationName: Human-readable site name assigned by Admin (e.g. 'Al Ain Industrial Site', 'Abudhabi Residential site')
columns.Description: Free-text description of the site entered by Admin
columns.StationCode: Short code identifier for the station (may be NULL)
columns.StationGuid: Unique GUID identifier for the station
columns.OrganizationName: Organisation that owns or operates the station
columns.SectorID: Foreign key to Sectors.Id — required at site creation. Values: 1=Commercial, 2=Public & Govt-School, 3=Industrial, 4=Residential
columns.SubSectorID: Foreign key to SubSectors.Id — optional. Values depend on SectorID (e.g. SectorID=2: 1=Gov, 2=Private; SectorID=1: 5=Institutional, 6=Commercial)
columns.RegionID: Foreign key to Regions.Id — required. Values: 1=Abudhabi, 2=AL Ain, 3=AlDhafra
columns.CoordinateX: Longitude coordinate for map display (decimal degrees, e.g. 24.19)
columns.CoordinateY: Latitude coordinate for map display (decimal degrees, e.g. 54.64)
columns.IsConfigChange: Flag indicating a configuration change is pending
columns.moldtest: Mold test flag: 1 = Yes (mold test enabled), 0 = No
columns.CreatedBy: UserID of the admin who created the site
columns.CreatedOn: Timestamp when the site was created
columns.ModifiedBy: UserID of the last admin who modified the site

DMN_Devices.description: Physical sensor devices installed at stations. Each device measures one or more parameters. Use this table to answer 'which devices can I see?', 'show my devices', or 'list devices at my sites' — RBAC automatically filters to the user's permitted stations via the StationID join.

columns.ID: Primary key — use as DeviceID in joins

DMN_Parameters.description: Dual-purpose table: (1) parameter/pollutant configuration per device, and (2) live current readings. Each device has a fixed set of parameters (e.g. 11 per device) and their ParameterValue + SubIndex are overwritten every 5 minutes with the latest sensor reading. Use this table for the CURRENT/LATEST value of any parameter. For historical data use ParameterReadings or ParameterAverages.
DMN_Parameters.live_data_note: ParameterValue is NOT historical — it always holds only the most recent reading for that parameter. One row per parameter per device, updated in-place every 5 minutes.

columns.ID: Primary key — use as ParameterID in joins
columns.ParameterID: Logical parameter type ID (same ParameterID across devices means same pollutant type)
columns.DriverID: Foreign key to the driver/protocol used by the device
columns.UnitID: Foreign key to ReportedUnits.ID — measurement unit
columns.ScaleFactor: Scaling factor applied to raw sensor value
columns.PollingInterval: How often the device is polled for data (seconds)
columns.Alarm: Current alarm state of the parameter
columns.ParameterValue: LIVE current value — overwritten every 5 minutes with the latest sensor reading
columns.IsCalculated: true = value is derived/calculated rather than directly measured
columns.DataSyncFrequency: Frequency of data sync to server
columns.ParameterReadingUpdateTime: Timestamp of the last ParameterValue update — indicates freshness of live data
columns.aeron_parameter_id: External Aeron system parameter reference ID
columns.shouldUseForAqi: true = this parameter contributes to AQI calculation
columns.Offset: Calibration offset applied to raw value
columns.IsConfigChange: Flag indicating a configuration change is pending
columns.SubIndex: Current AQI sub-index for this parameter — updated every 5 minutes alongside ParameterValue
columns.LastCommunicationTime: Timestamp of last successful communication from the device

DMN_Flags.description: Data quality flags used in LoggerFlags column of readings.

DeviceCompliance.description: Daily device compliance/uptime tracking. Records whether each device was active on a given date.

columns.IsActive: true = device was active/reporting on this date

Parameters_Excedence_Values.description: MOCCAE standard exceedance threshold values per pollutant and averaging interval.

columns.Interval: Averaging interval in hours (1 = 1-hour avg, 8 = 8-hour avg, 24 = 24-hour avg)
columns.ExcedenceValue: Threshold value — readings above this are exceedances

ReportedUnits.description: Measurement units for parameter values (e.g. µg/m³, ppm, °C, %).

Sectors.description: Fixed lookup table for site sector classification. Sectors are predefined and cannot be changed by users — Admin selects one when creating a site.

SubSectors.description: Fixed lookup table for site sub-sector classification. Each sub-sector belongs to a parent Sector via SectorID. Admin selects an optional sub-sector when creating a site.

columns.SectorID: Foreign key to Sectors.Id — which sector this sub-sector belongs to

Regions.description: Fixed lookup table for geographic region classification. Regions represent administrative areas in UAE. Admin selects a region (required) when creating a site.

DMN_StationGrouping.description: Groups of stations for dashboard/report filtering.

join_patterns.readings_with_station_and_parameter: SELECT pr.*, s.StationName, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName FROM ParameterReadings pr JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pr.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pr.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID
join_patterns.averages_with_station_and_parameter: SELECT pa.*, s.StationName, p.ParameterName, u.UnitName FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN ReportedUnits u ON p.UnitID = u.ID
join_patterns.stations_with_sector_subsector_region: SELECT s.ID, s.StationName, s.OrganizationName, s.Status, s.moldtest, sec.SectorName, sub.SectorName AS SubSectorName, r.RegionName, s.CoordinateX, s.CoordinateY FROM DMN_Stations s LEFT JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id LEFT JOIN SubSectors sub ON s.SubSectorID = sub.Id LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id

site_query_examples.list all active sites: SELECT s.StationName, sec.SectorName, sub.SectorName AS SubSectorName, r.RegionName FROM DMN_Stations s LEFT JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id LEFT JOIN SubSectors sub ON s.SubSectorID = sub.Id LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id WHERE s.Status = 1 ORDER BY s.StationName
site_query_examples.sites in a region: SELECT s.StationName, sec.SectorName, r.RegionName FROM DMN_Stations s LEFT JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id WHERE r.RegionName = @regionName AND s.Status = 1
site_query_examples.sites in a sector: SELECT s.StationName, sec.SectorName, sub.SectorName AS SubSectorName FROM DMN_Stations s LEFT JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id LEFT JOIN SubSectors sub ON s.SubSectorID = sub.Id WHERE sec.SectorName = @sectorName AND s.Status = 1
site_query_examples.sites with mold test enabled: SELECT s.StationName, sec.SectorName, r.RegionName FROM DMN_Stations s LEFT JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id WHERE s.moldtest = 1 AND s.Status = 1
site_query_examples.count sites by sector: SELECT sec.SectorName, COUNT(*) AS SiteCount FROM DMN_Stations s JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id WHERE s.Status = 1 GROUP BY sec.SectorName ORDER BY SiteCount DESC
site_query_examples.count sites by region: SELECT r.RegionName, COUNT(*) AS SiteCount FROM DMN_Stations s JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id WHERE s.Status = 1 GROUP BY r.RegionName ORDER BY SiteCount DESC
